Shape::WITNESS named DefEqBinder and described it as the deepest-per-level descent, i.e. the one that overflows first. The measurement contradicts that: defeq binder congruence uses two kernel frames per level and is nonetheless the CHEAPEST of the four, so it overflows LAST. COST: twelve subprocess probes, no bisection, 0.18 seconds for the whole file including the four pre-existing guards. The stack is 4 MiB on purpose -- the prediction substitutes STACK_ENTRY_RESERVE_BYTES for the measured intercept, an error under 1% at that size and 4% at 1 MiB, which at 1 MiB would eat into the band.

IT BRACKETS RATHER THAN RE-DERIVES. The check never recomputes the constant and compares the result to itself, which would be the same number twice and would prove nothing. It asks the real descent questions whose answers are only all correct when the claim is true, and it takes the claim as a PARAMETER so the planted violations can hand it deliberately wrong numbers -- half the true cost, three times the true cost, and an entry reserve of 8 KiB -- and require a refusal naming the specific direction. A check that cannot fail is a rubber stamp.

THE DRIFT IS MEASURED, NOT HYPOTHESISED. Two observations on 2026-07-25, both on franken_lean-kxbj's row: the same instrument read 5,935.3 bytes/depth on the development host and 6,553.6 on an RCH remote worker at the identical (profile, arch, os); and widening Budget for franken_lean-4o3n cost two of the four shapes one level of ceiling. THE GUARDS THAT ALREADY EXISTED PROVE SURVIVAL AT THE SHIPPED PAIRING, which is a different claim from the shipped number still describing the descent. With STACK_SAFETY_FACTOR at 2 and MIN_STACK_BYTES rounded up on top of it there is roughly 3x of headroom in which MEASURED_STACK_BYTES_PER_DEPTH can be fiction and every test still passes -- and when the headroom finally runs out the guard does not fail, it aborts the test binary uncatchably. The tripwire turns the safety factor from a silent absorber of drift into a margin with a tripwire in it.

THE TOLERANCES ARE JUSTIFIED RATHER THAN PICKED. High 25%: that is 2.4x the largest host-to-host spread yet observed (10.4%), so ordinary machine variation cannot redden the tree, and it is half of STACK_SAFETY_FACTOR, so it fires with the whole margin still unspent. Low 33%, deliberately looser, because the directions differ in consequence -- an understated constant is the direction that aborts processes, while an overstated one is not a safety failure but silently shrinks depth_for_stack_bytes for every caller and manufactures typed non-answers that nobody can tell from real ones, which under franken_lean-4o3n is exactly what erodes a consensus seat.

THE TWO DIRECTIONS ARE QUANTIFIED DIFFERENTLY, and getting that wrong would have made this a flake generator rather than a guard. ABOVE the claim is a property of ANY shape -- one descent costing more than the constant says is enough to make MIN_STACK_BYTES promise too little. BELOW the claim is a property of ALL shapes at once, because the constant is the MAXIMUM over the four descents and a single cheap descent is not evidence that it is overstated. defeq_binder measures 4,507 bytes/depth against the shipped 5,935, which is 24% below it BY DESIGN; a per-shape low bound would have parked a permanent tripwire 9 points from a correct value, and the first person to see it fire would have widened the band rather than read it.
